price.hint: Unit prices are per 1M tokens. Models without custom prices use built-in estimates: GLM-5.3, DeepSeek V4, Qwen3.8-Max are verified official list prices; gpt-6 series (astra / sol / luna) and claude fable series are OpenRouter live prices converted at the exchange rate; others are estimates — calibrate against your actual bills. Enter values row by row, then click Save.

footer.text: Cost basis: non-cached input = totalInputTokens - totalCacheReadInputTokens (floored at 0); cache read = totalCacheReadInputTokens; cache write = totalCacheCreationInputTokens; output = totalOutputTokens; cost = tokens / 1,000,000 x unit price (prices per 1M tokens, currency symbol configurable). The daily/models dimensions have no effective split, so costs are approximate; daily cost is apportioned by each token category's blended full-period price and may differ slightly from the per-model total. Data comes from the usage metadata domain, polled every 5 seconds. Time filtering follows the official usage page convention (start 00:00:00 ~ end 23:59:59), with presets today / yesterday / last 7 days / last 30 days / this month / last month / custom range plus profile and project filters; filter state is persisted in plugin-local storage. Models without custom prices are billed at built-in estimates for reference only — calibrate them in Unit Price Settings.
